description: Resolve a creator to their existing Jovie profile, or extract public fields from a YouTube channel. Accepts a profile URL or platform:handle (youtube, instagram, tiktok, linktree); Instagram, TikTok, and Linktree only resolve existing profiles. Never creates a profile.

url-or-handle.description: Creator profile URL or platform:handle, e.g. youtube:@creator

name: lookup_creator
